applicabilityBasis.summary: ftUSD is a non-yielding dollar-targeted base token marketed for payments and onchain settlement. Product documentation describes conversion into supported collateral assets at a quoted prevailing rate, while the interface terms disclaim Company involvement in underlying protocol transactions. The opened sources do not establish a legal issuer obligation to redeem ftUSD for a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value; that statutory element remains unresolved.

genius.notes: Reviewed on 2026-10-07. ftUSD is the non-yielding payment and settlement base, distinct from the sftUSD and ssftUSD savings receipts. The product documentation provides conversion into supported collateral at a prevailing rate, not a confirmed contractual 1:1 national-currency redemption obligation. Applicability therefore remains unclear. The official English terms identify Flying Tulip Ltd only as interface provider and disclaim involvement in underlying protocol transactions; issuerEntity is omitted because those terms do not identify the legal ftUSD issuer. The collateral API discloses token supply, collateral balances and withdrawal parameters, so reserveDisclosurePresent records first-party disclosure rather than independent assurance. No fixed-value redemption-policy or monthly-attestation boolean is asserted. No qualifying public GENIUS authorization was found in the named public sources; this does not resolve an unidentified issuer's confidential or unindexed filings. The GENIUS DASP restrictions remain prospective under the opened Treasury proposal.
